text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hail, hail, Lord Gimlet~~! I managed to 
make it in time for your birthday~~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm, I heard they have exquisite matcha in 
the capital! Along with grapes from Koshu, 
strawberries from Shimotsuke, salt from 
the south, and top-tier goods from all 
directions—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Do you dare command me? To craft a 
chalice that leads to paradise?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
These are the finest ingredients! No 
matter how they're mixed, it's bound to 
make a delicious bowl!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how you mix it," huh! 
Fascinating!! However, I shall forge the 
ultimate pinnacle from the finite!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: No Reason, I accept your challenge! And—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The cups I will craft from here on... will 
certainly not stop at just one. That box 
from earlier was quite large, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Will you join me, No Reason? In the 
ultimate creation I am about to forge. I 
shall reach into your unknown...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you say it will surpass even my 
imagination! As expected of Gimlet-dono, I 
can hardly wait~âª

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now then— allow me to properly savor this.
